-- Ultra Instinct: Player + Unanchored Part Dodge
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Use a LocalScript

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local DODGE_DISTANCE = 5
local PART_DODGE_DISTANCE = 3

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MIN = 3
local TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MAX = 5

local DODGE_COOLDOWN = 0.35
local lastDodge = 0

local function findNearbyThreat(myRoot)
    -- Check nearby players
    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= player then
            local character = otherPlayer.Character
            local root = character
                and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = character
                and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    <= DODGE_DISTANCE then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Check nearby unanchored parts
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
        myRoot.Position,
        PART_DODGE_DISTANCE
    )) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart")
            and not part.Anchored
            and not part:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then

            -- Ignore parts belonging to player characters
            local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local isCharacter = model
                and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)

            if not isCharacter then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function randomDodge(character, myRoot)
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random(
        TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MIN,
        TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MAX
    )

    local offset = Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )

    local destination = myRoot.Position + offset

    -- Find the ground at the destination
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        destination + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0),
        Vector3.new(0, -40, 0),
        rayParams
    )

    if result then
        destination = Vector3.new(
            destination.X,
            result.Position.Y + 3,
            destination.Z
        )
    else
        destination = Vector3.new(
            destination.X,
            myRoot.Position.Y,
            destination.Z
        )
    end

    character:PivotTo(
        CFrame.new(destination) * myRoot.CFrame.Rotation
    )
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if os.clock() - lastDodge < DODGE_COOLDOWN then
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local myRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not myRoot or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    if findNearbyThreat(myRoot) then
        lastDodge = os.clock()
        randomDodge(character, myRoot)
    end
end)

scripts.script:
local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
local logs = game:GetService("LogService")

local setclip = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set)

local function getLogs(console)
    local lines = {}
    local scroller = console:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame", true)
    
    if scroller then
        for _, v in ipairs(scroller:GetDescendants()) do
            if (v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextBox")) and v.Text ~= "" then
                table.insert(lines, {
                    order = v.LayoutOrder,
                    y = v.AbsolutePosition.Y,
                    text = v.Text
                })
            end
        end
    end

    if #lines > 0 then
        table.sort(lines, function(a, b)
            if a.order ~= 0 and b.order ~= 0 and a.order ~= b.order then
                return a.order < b.order
            end
            return a.y < b.y
        end)
        local res = {}
        for i = 1, #lines do
            res[i] = lines[i].text
        end
        return table.concat(res, "\n")
    end

    local history = logs:GetLogHistory()
    local raw = {}
    for i, item in ipairs(history) do
        raw[i] = item.message
    end
    return table.concat(raw, "\n")
end

local function checkValid(btn)
    if not (btn and btn:IsA("GuiObject") and btn.Name == "Clear") then return false end
    local buttons = btn.Parent
    if not (buttons and buttons.Name == "Buttons") then return false end
    local rConsole = buttons.Parent
    if not (rConsole and rConsole.Name == "RobloxConsole") then return false end
    local console = rConsole.Parent
    return (console and console.Name == "Console")
end

local function init()
    for _, obj in ipairs(cg:GetDescendants()) do
        if checkValid(obj) then
            local buttons = obj.Parent
            local rConsole = buttons.Parent
            
            if not buttons:FindFirstChild("Copy") then
                local copy = obj:Clone()
                copy.Name = "Copy"
                
                local title = copy:FindFirstChild("Title")
                if title then title.Text = "Copy" end
                
                local layout = buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
                if layout then
                    copy.LayoutOrder = obj.LayoutOrder + 1
                else
                    local w = obj.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and (obj.AbsoluteSize.X + 8) or 65
                    copy.Position = UDim2.new(obj.Position.X.Scale, obj.Position.X.Offset + w, obj.Position.Y.Scale, obj.Position.Y.Offset)
                end
                
                local defaultColor = copy.BackgroundColor3
                local busy = false
                
                local tIn = ts:Create(copy, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 175, 85)
                })
                local tOut = ts:Create(copy, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = defaultColor
                })
                
                local function handleClick()
                    if busy then return end
                    busy = true
                    
                    if setclip then
                        setclip(getLogs(rConsole))
                    end
                    
                    if title then title.Text = "Copied!" end
                    tIn:Play()
                    
                    task.delay(1, function()
                        tOut:Play()
                        if title and title.Parent then
                            title.Text = "Copy"
                        end
                        task.wait(0.35)
                        busy = false
                    end)
                end
                
                if copy:IsA("GuiButton") then
                    copy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleClick)
                else
                    local subBtn = copy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton", true)
                    if subBtn then subBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleClick) end
                end
                
                copy.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        handleClick()
                    end
                end)
                
                copy.Parent = buttons
            end
        end
    end
end

cg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
    if checkValid(desc) then
        task.wait(0.1)
        init()
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(init)
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)

-- Остаточна версія: Розширений Інвентар + DROP (Стійкий до смерті)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Вимикаємо стандартний обмежений інвентар Roblox
StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)

-- Очищення старих копій скрипта (якщо вони зависли в пам'яті Delta)
local oldGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("DeltaMegaInventoryGui")
if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

-- Створення головного GUI контейнера
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "DeltaMegaInventoryGui"
ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false -- Захист від видалення інтерфейсу грою

-- Створення прокручуваної панелі інвентарю
local ScrollingFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ScrollingFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
ScrollingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.12, 0)
ScrollingFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.85, 0) -- Знизу екрана по центру
ScrollingFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
ScrollingFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4
ScrollingFrame.Active = true

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Parent = ScrollingFrame
UIListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
UIListLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

-- Створення кнопки DROP (на старому зручному місці)
local DropButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local DropCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
DropButton.Name = "DropButton"
DropButton.Parent = ScreenGui
DropButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
DropButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.35, 0) 
DropButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 70)
DropButton.Text = "DROP"
DropButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DropButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
DropButton.TextSize = 16
DropButton.Active = true
DropButton.Draggable = true
DropCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 30)
DropCorner.Parent = DropButton

-- Розумна функція, яка завжди шукає новий рюкзак і оновлює слоти
local function refreshInventory()
    -- Очищаємо візуальні кнопки перед перемальовкою
    for _, child in ipairs(ScrollingFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
    end

    -- Завжди беремо найсвіжіший рюкзак та персонажа
    local activeBackpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local currentCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    local tools = {}

    if activeBackpack then
        for _, t in ipairs(activeBackpack:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(tools, t) end
        end
    end
    if currentCharacter then
        for _, t in ipairs(currentCharacter:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(tools, t) end
        end
    end

    -- Створюємо слоти для предметів
    for _, tool in ipairs(tools) do
        local ToolButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
        local ToolCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        
        ToolButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
        ToolButton.BackgroundColor3 = (tool.Parent == currentCharacter) and Color3.fromRGB(80, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        ToolButton.Text = tool.Name
        ToolButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        ToolButton.TextWrapped = true
        ToolButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        ToolButton.TextSize = 12
        ToolButton.Parent = ScrollingFrame
        
        ToolCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        ToolCorner.Parent = ToolButton
        
        ToolButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                if tool.Parent == char then
                    char.Humanoid:UnequipTools()
                else
                    char.Humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, #tools * 75, 0, 0)
end

-- Динамічне підключення тригерів, яке автоматично перезапускається після смерті
local function setupConnections()
    local currentCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local activeBackpack = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack")

    -- Слідкуємо за змінами в поточному інвентарі
    local bAdd = activeBackpack.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshInventory)
    local bRem = activeBackpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(refreshInventory)
    local cAdd = currentCharacter.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshInventory)
    local cRem = currentCharacter.ChildRemoved:Connect(refreshInventory)

    -- Якщо персонаж помре — відключаємо старі зв'язки і чекаємо новий респавн
    local deathConnection
    deathConnection = currentCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid").Died:Connect(function()
        bAdd:Disconnect()
        bRem:Disconnect()
        cAdd:Disconnect()
        cRem:Disconnect()
        deathConnection:Disconnect()
    end)

    refreshInventory()
end

-- Запуск відстеження при кожному новому відродженні (CharacterAdded)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.8) -- Невелика пауза, поки гра створює новий Backpack після смерті
    StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) -- Повторно приховуємо стандартний інтерфейс
    setupConnections()
end)

-- Перший запуск при інжекте скрипта
if LocalPlayer.Character then
    setupConnections()
end

-- Логіка мобільного DROP (викидання без збоїв джойстика)
DropButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
            local spawnPart = character:FindFirstChild("RightArm") or character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            tool.Parent = Workspace
            if spawnPart then
                tool:MoveTo(spawnPart.Position + (spawnPart.CFrame.LookVector * 4))
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
--[[
	rocheese.luau - RoChess! engine panel + autopilot
	Luau, Real executor, client side.

	Uses the game's own modules instead of re-implementing chess:
		ReplicatedStorage.Chess.Engine       board, legal moves, UCI/SAN, FEN
		ReplicatedStorage.Chess.Bot          local search: analyse(fen,moves,sec,depth) / think(fen,moves,persona)
		ReplicatedStorage.Chess.VortexBot    server engine bridge: analyse / think
		ReplicatedStorage.ChessClient.App    live client state: session, board, onBoardMove, playMove

	Squares use Engine.algToIndex64 (bottom-up, a1 = 1, h8 = 64).
	Engine scores are always from WHITE's side of the board.

	Panel: top-right, drag it by the title.
	Arrows on the board:
		green  = best move      blue = second best      yellow = third best

	Presets:
		LEGIT  local engine, plays like a 1500 human (noise + blunders), 5-10s per move
		RAJ    server engine (Vortex), always the best move, plays fast

	Controls: STYLE, DELAY min/max, PLAY BEST/ELO, ENGINE LOCAL/VORTEX, AUTOPLAY,
	          PLAY NOW, COPY FEN, BOT GAME.
	Hotkeys: End auto | Home arrow | PageUp hide | PageDown source | Insert copy fen.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Chess = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Chess")
local Client = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ChessClient")

local function req(mod)
	return require(mod)
end

local Engine = req(Chess:WaitForChild("Engine"))
local Bot = req(Chess:WaitForChild("Bot"))
local VortexBot = req(Chess:WaitForChild("VortexBot"))
local App = req(Client:WaitForChild("App"))

local GENV = getgenv()
GENV.__RoCheeseGen = (GENV.__RoCheeseGen or 0) + 1
local GEN = GENV.__RoCheeseGen

local CFG = {
	W = 344,
	H = 424,
	MARGIN = 14,
	TOP = 84,
	DEPTH = 16,
	SECONDS = 0.8,
	CHILD_DEPTH = 8,
	CHILD_SECONDS = 0.06,
	VK_SHIFT = 160,
	PROMO = { q = 5, r = 4, b = 3, n = 2 },
	ARROW_1 = Color3.fromRGB(129, 182, 76),
	ARROW_2 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 156, 240),
	ARROW_3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 70),
	DELAY_MIN = 0,
	DELAY_MAX = 20,
	DELAY_STEP = 0.5,
}

local PRESETS = {
	legit = {
		label = "LEGIT",
		source = "local",
		mode = "elo",
		elo = 1500,
		noise = 0.32,
		blunder = 0.06,
		delayMin = 5,
		delayMax = 10,
	},
	raj = {
		label = "RAJ",
		source = "vortex",
		mode = "best",
		elo = 1800,
		noise = 0,
		blunder = 0,
		delayMin = 0.5,
		delayMax = 1.5,
	},
}

local RUNTIME = GENV.__RoCheese or {}
RUNTIME.SHOW_ARROW = RUNTIME.SHOW_ARROW ~= false
RUNTIME.AUTO = RUNTIME.AUTO == true
RUNTIME.HUMANIZE = RUNTIME.HUMANIZE ~= false
RUNTIME.SOURCE = RUNTIME.SOURCE == "vortex" and "vortex" or "local"
RUNTIME.MODE = RUNTIME.MODE == "best" and "best" or "elo"
RUNTIME.ELO = tonumber(RUNTIME.ELO) or 1500
RUNTIME.NOISE = tonumber(RUNTIME.NOISE) or 0.32
RUNTIME.BLUNDER = tonumber(RUNTIME.BLUNDER) or 0.06
RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN = math.clamp(tonumber(RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN) or 5, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX)
RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX = math.clamp(tonumber(RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX) or 10, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX)
RUNTIME.STYLE = RUNTIME.STYLE == "raj" and "raj" or (RUNTIME.STYLE == "legit" and "legit" or "custom")
GENV.__RoCheese = RUNTIME

local ARROW_KEYS = { "rc1", "rc2", "rc3" }

local S = {
	ply = -1,
	sessionId = nil,
	best = nil,
	san = nil,
	score = 0,
	depth = 0,
	second = nil,
	third = nil,
	secondSan = nil,
	thirdSan = nil,
	busy = false,
	autoAt = 0,
	thinkAt = 0,
	status = "loading",
}
GENV.__RoCheeseState = S

local LIVE = _G.STATE

local function alive()
	if GENV.__RoCheeseGen ~= GEN then
		return false
	end
	if typeof(LIVE) == "table" and type(LIVE.alive) == "function" then
		return LIVE.alive()
	end
	return true
end

local function cleanup(fn)
	if typeof(LIVE) == "table" and type(LIVE.onCleanup) == "function" then
		LIVE.onCleanup(fn)
	end
end

-- board ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function clearArrows()
	local board = App.board
	if not board or type(board.setArrow) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	for _, key in ARROW_KEYS do
		pcall(function()
			board:setArrow(key, nil)
			board:setTint(key, nil)
		end)
	end
	-- older build of this script used a single arrow key
	pcall(function()
		board:setArrow("rocheese", nil)
		board:setTint("rocheese", nil)
	end)
end

local function drawArrow(key, uci, color, tint)
	local board = App.board
	if not board then
		return
	end
	local from = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(1, 2))
	local to = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(3, 4))
	if not from or not to then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		board:setArrow(key, from, to, color, 0.12)
		if tint then
			board:setTint(key, to, color, 0.26)
		end
	end)
end

-- engine ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function buildEngine(startFen, moves)
	local engine = Engine.new(startFen)
	for _, uci in ipairs(moves) do
		local mv = engine:moveFromUci(uci)
		if not mv then
			return nil
		end
		engine:play(mv)
	end
	return engine
end

local function sanOf(engine, uci)
	if not engine or not uci then
		return nil
	end
	local want = string.lower(uci)
	for _, mv in engine:legalMoves() do
		local u = engine:moveToUci(mv)
		if u and string.lower(u) == want then
			return engine:moveToSan(mv)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function analyseBest(startFen, moves)
	if RUNTIME.SOURCE == "vortex" then
		local ok, res = pcall(VortexBot.analyse, startFen, moves, CFG.SECONDS, CFG.DEPTH)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.best then
			return res
		end
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(Bot.analyse, startFen, moves, CFG.SECONDS, CFG.DEPTH)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		return res
	end
	return nil
end

-- ranks every continuation of the position, so the 2nd and 3rd arrows have a real order
local function rankContinuations(startFen, moves, skipUci)
	local engine = buildEngine(startFen, moves)
	if not engine then
		return nil
	end
	local scored = {}
	for _, mv in engine:legalMoves() do
		local uci = engine:moveToUci(mv)
		if not skipUci or string.lower(uci) ~= string.lower(skipUci) then
			local child = Engine.new(startFen)
			local ok = pcall(function()
				child:playUci(uci)
			end)
			if ok then
				local cres = Bot.analyse(child:getFen(), {}, CFG.CHILD_SECONDS, CFG.CHILD_DEPTH)
				table.insert(scored, {
					uci = uci,
					san = engine:moveToSan(mv),
					score = tonumber(cres and cres.score) or 0,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(scored, function(a, b)
		return a.score > b.score
	end)
	return scored
end

local function pickMove(session)
	if RUNTIME.MODE == "elo" then
		local ok, uci = pcall(Bot.think, session.startFen, table.clone(session.ucis), {
			rating = RUNTIME.ELO,
			noise = RUNTIME.NOISE,
			blunder = RUNTIME.BLUNDER,
			time = 0.6,
			depth = 14,
		})
		if ok and type(uci) == "string" then
			return uci
		end
	end
	return S.best
end

-- playing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function tapInput()
	if not RUNTIME.HUMANIZE then
		return
	end
	if type(keyclick) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	if type(isrbxactive) == "function" and not isrbxactive() then
		return
	end
	pcall(keyclick, CFG.VK_SHIFT)
end

local function playUci(uci)
	local session = App.session
	if not session or session.over then
		return false, "no game"
	end
	if not session:isMyTurn() then
		return false, "not your turn"
	end
	local from = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(1, 2))
	local to = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(3, 4))
	if not from or not to then
		return false, "bad uci"
	end
	local promo = CFG.PROMO[uci:sub(5, 5)] or 0
	local before = #session.ucis
	tapInput()
	local ok = false
	pcall(function()
		-- same call a square click makes: local apply + packed move to the server
		ok = App.onBoardMove(from, to, promo, nil)
	end)
	if not ok or #session.ucis == before then
		pcall(function()
			App.playMove(uci)
		end)
	end
	return true, uci
end

local function humanDelay()
	local lo = math.min(RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN, RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX)
	local hi = math.max(RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN, RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX)
	if hi - lo < 0.2 then
		return lo
	end
	return lo + math.random() * (hi - lo)
end

local function autopilotTick(session, ply)
	if not RUNTIME.AUTO then
		return
	end
	if session.over or not session:isMyTurn() then
		return
	end
	if session.viewPly ~= ply or S.busy or not S.best then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < S.thinkAt then
		return
	end
	local uci = pickMove(session)
	if type(uci) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		if not alive() then
			return
		end
		if App.session == session and not session.over and session:isMyTurn() then
			playUci(uci)
		end
	end)
end

-- gui -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local gui = nil
local panel = nil
local rows = {}
local btns = {}
local dot = nil
local dragged = false
local lastEval = nil

-- forward declarations: the buttons are wired before these are defined
local toggleAuto, playNow, copyPosition, refreshButtons, syncDelay, applyPreset, startBotGame

local C_BG = Color3.fromRGB(17, 18, 22)
local C_IDLE = Color3.fromRGB(36, 39, 46)
local C_ON = Color3.fromRGB(52, 104, 60)
local C_RAJ = Color3.fromRGB(148, 54, 48)
local C_TXT = Color3.fromRGB(236, 238, 241)
local C_DIM = Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 176)
local C_ACC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)

local function mkText(parent, y, h, size, color, bold, x)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CFG.W - 28 - (x or 14), h)
	t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x or 14, y)
	t.Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham
	t.TextSize = size
	t.TextColor3 = color
	t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	t.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	t.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	t.Parent = parent
	return t
end

local function mkButton(y, h, text, width, onClick)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.BackgroundColor3 = C_IDLE
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.AutoButtonColor = false
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width or (CFG.W - 28), h)
	b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, y)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextSize = 12
	b.TextColor3 = C_TXT
	b.Text = text
	b.Parent = panel
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	c.Parent = b
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	s.Thickness = 1
	s.Transparency = 0.85
	s.Parent = b
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		s.Transparency = 0.45
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		s.Transparency = 0.85
	end)
	return b
end

local function setBtn(b, on, text, onColor)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = on and (onColor or C_ON) or C_IDLE
	b.Text = text
end

local function mkSeparator(y)
	local sep = Instance.new("Frame")
	sep.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	sep.BackgroundTransparency = 0.87
	sep.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sep.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CFG.W - 28, 1)
	sep.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, y)
	sep.Parent = panel
	return sep
end

local function mkDot(x, y, color, size)
	local d = Instance.new("Frame")
	d.BackgroundColor3 = color
	d.BorderSizePixel = 0
	d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size or 9, size or 9)
	d.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	d.Parent = panel
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	c.Parent = d
	return d
end

-- delay row: MIN / MAX steppers, every press is one step, no dragging ----------------------

local function mkDelayRow(y)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CFG.W - 28, 26)
	row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, y)
	row.Parent = panel

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 26)
	title.Text = "DELAY"
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 11
	title.TextColor3 = C_DIM
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = row

	local values = {}

	local function stepper(x, name, getVal, setVal)
		local lab = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lab.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 26)
		lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0)
		lab.Text = name
		lab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		lab.TextSize = 11
		lab.TextColor3 = C_DIM
		lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lab.Parent = row

		local function smallButton(px, sign)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.BackgroundColor3 = C_IDLE
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
			b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, 2)
			b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			b.TextSize = 13
			b.TextColor3 = C_TXT
			b.Text = sign
			b.Parent = row
			local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
			c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
			c.Parent = b
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			s.Thickness = 1
			s.Transparency = 0.85
			s.Parent = b

			local holding = false
			local function step()
				setVal(getVal() + (sign == "+" and CFG.DELAY_STEP or -CFG.DELAY_STEP))

local setDelay = function(lo, hi)
	lo = math.clamp(tonumber(lo) or RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX)
	hi = math.clamp(tonumber(hi) or RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX)
	if hi < lo then
		lo, hi = hi, lo
	end
	RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN = math.floor(lo / CFG.DELAY_STEP + 0.5) * CFG.DELAY_STEP
	RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX = math.floor(hi / CFG.DELAY_STEP + 0.5) * CFG.DELAY_STEP
	if RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX - RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN < CFG.DELAY_STEP then
		RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX = RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN + CFG.DELAY_STEP
	end
	RUNTIME.STYLE = "custom"

	end
	refreshButtons()

-- the game already ships a chess-style eval bar next to the board, it is just never
-- switched on during a normal game. Feeding it our score wakes it up.
local GAME_KINDS = {
	bot = true,
	online = true,
	puzzle = true,
	rush = true,
}

local function pushEval()
	local session = App.session
	local kind = session and session.kind
	if not session or not kind or not GAME_KINDS[kind] then
		lastEval = nil
		return
	end
	if S.busy or not S.best then
		return
	end
	local score = S.score
	if lastEval == score then
		return
	end
	lastEval = score
	local mate = nil
	if math.abs(score) >= 29900 then
		mate = math.max(1, math.floor((30000 - math.abs(score)) / 100 + 0.5))
	end
	pcall(function()
		App.setEval(score, mate)
	end)
end

local function formatClock(ms)
	if type(ms) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	ms = math.max(0, ms)
	local total = math.floor(ms / 1000)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(total / 60), total % 60)
end

local function evalText(score)
	local abs = math.abs(score)
	if abs >= 29900 then
		local moves = math.max(1, math.floor((30000 - abs) / 100 + 0.5))
		return string.format("M%d %s", moves, score > 0 and "white" or "black")
	end
	local pawns = score / 100
	return string.format("%s%.2f", pawns >= 0 and "+" or "", pawns)
end

local function refreshPanel(session, ply)
	if not panel or not panel.Parent then
		return
	end

	rows.title.Text = "ROCHESS ENGINE"
	rows.status.Text = S.status
	rows.eval.Text = session
		and (S.busy and "EVAL ...      DEPTH ..." or string.format("EVAL %s      DEPTH %d", evalText(S.score), S.depth))
		or "EVAL -      DEPTH 0"
	if S.busy then
		rows.best.Text = "1 thinking..."
		rows.rest.Text = ""
	else
		rows.best.Text = S.best and string.format("1  %s   (%s)", S.san or "?", S.best) or "1  -"
		local parts = {}
		if S.second then
			table.insert(parts, string.format("2  %s", S.secondSan or S.second))
		end
		if S.third then
			table.insert(parts, string.format("3  %s", S.thirdSan or S.third))
		end
		rows.rest.Text = table.concat(parts, "     ")
	end
	local myClock, oppClock = "-", "-"
	if session and session.clocks and session.myColor then
		myClock = formatClock(session.clocks[session.myColor])
		oppClock = formatClock(session.clocks[-session.myColor])
	end
	rows.game.Text = session
		and string.format("%s | ply %d | clock %s/%s",
			session.myColor == 1 and (session.white and session.white.display or "white")
				or (session.black and session.black.display or "black"),
			ply,
			myClock,
			oppClock)
		or "no game"

	if session and session.kind == "idle" then
		rows.status.Text = "no game running - press BOT GAME or Play in the game"
	end

	if dot then
		if S.busy then
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = C_ACC
		elseif S.best then
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = CFG.ARROW_1
		else
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 70)
		end
	end

	pushEval()
end
